answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, verifiable honest service to retain influence; a burst of endorsements quickly loses weight as the tide turns. Under EigenTrust-style matrix factorization, fresh Sybil identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality, and reciprocity-weighted transitivity prevents them from borrowing trust through circular ratings. A quill’s first mark at dawn cannot create the history needed to pass consensus.
